verdict.rationale: Foreloop supports natural-language task descriptions ('Users can't tell which invoices are overdue') that agents turn into tasks, and it exposes MCP/CLI interfaces for agents to operate on projects, suggesting agentic, natural-language-driven workflows. However, all evidence is vendor documentation with no independent/hands-on confirmation, and much of the interaction still requires structured CLI/MCP commands and human approval gates rather than pure natural-language control.
